why: rowStep: the band metric's step part, max |row-mean step| (any channel, 0-255) down the hero's bottom third and 8 CSS px into MissionBlock, content boxes masked; BASE 16.0-17.0 on every slide (the bone->parchment seam), the golden fix simulated on BASE 2.5-4.3 (the steepest part of the pull). sourceBpp: the band metric's starvation part, source bytes x 8 / delivered pixels of the active slide; BASE yellow 0.46-0.53, the lowest kept slide is pink at 1.38 (2048 wide) and 1.57 (1920). seam: last hero row vs first MissionBlock row, per channel. Calibration numbers: goldens/f1-calibration.json.
